papers.title: Beyond MPB engineering: enhanced piezoelectricity and thermal stability assisted by high-entropy design
papers.summary: The pursuit of ferroelectric materials that combine a high piezoelectric response with robust thermal stability remains a paramount challenge. We introduce a strategy that integrates morphotropic phase boundary (MPB) engineering with high-entropy (HE) design in a novel quinary Pb(Yb1/2Nb1/2)O3-Pb(Zn1/3Nb2/3)O3-Pb(Fe1/2Nb1/2)O3-PbZrO3-PbTiO3 (PYN-PZN-PFN-PZ-PT) perovskite ceramic. Compared to a medium-entropy counterpart, the high-entropy composition yields a superior piezoelectric coefficient of 580 pC/N and exceptional thermal stability, with performance retained up to 285 °C. This enhancement arises from two synergistic effects of the HE design: a stabilized, flattened free-energy landscape that promotes a favorable nanoscale domain structure and improves depolarization behavior, together with higher electrical resistivity (1012 Ω·cm at 250 °C) arising from HE-driven grain refinement and suppressed charge transport. This work demonstrates that HE design serves as an effective strategy to mitigate the traditional trade-off between piezoelectric response and depolarization temperature in Pb-based relaxor ferroelectrics.

papers.title: Mitigating lead toxicity towards safer commercialization of perovskite solar cells
papers.summary: Metal halide perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have emerged as transformative photovoltaic technologies due to their high efficiency and low cost. However, the presence of lead raises environmental and health concerns, posing a barrier to commercialization. This Review quantifies the toxicity risks associated with lead in PSCs and underscores the need for effective mitigation strategies. We discuss the long-term effectiveness of lead isolation and immobilization approaches by introducing quantitative metrics, specifically the sequestration efficiency and lifetime. We further evaluate the practical feasibility of these strategies in terms of device efficiency, scalability and cost. In addition, we explore sustainable lead sources and advocate for the leveraging of lead–acid battery recycling as a transitional supply, ultimately aiming to establish a closed-loop lead recycling system for PSCs. By integrating lead-sequestration strategies, establishing recycling infrastructure for end-of-life perovskite photovoltaics and advancing producer responsibility policies, this Review provides a roadmap towards the safer and more sustainable commercialization of lead-based perovskite photovoltaics.

**学术价值**：为PSCs铅管理提供了从毒性量化到闭环回收的标准化评估框架，推动领域从“效率优先”转向“安全-性能协同”的理性设计范式。

papers.title: Amphiphilic molecular binder strengthens atomic layer-deposited SnOx for reliable perovskite solar cells
papers.summary: We designed an amphiphilic semiconductor PDI-4OH to resolve interface instability in perovskite solar cells (PSCs). It functions as a molecular template that guides uniform atomic layer deposition (ALD) of SnOx and interlocks the ETL/ALD SnOx interface. This strategy enables inverted PSCs to achieve a champion efficiency of 27.08% with exceptional operational stability under high-temperature, damp heat, and thermal cycling stresses, offering a universal and scalable path toward commercial perovskite photovoltaics.

**策略/方法**：设计两亲性半导体分子PDI-4OH作为分子模板，其亲水端引导ALD SnOx均匀成核，疏水端与钙钛矿形成强键合，实现ETL/钙钛矿界面的机械互锁。

**机理/发现**：PDI-4OH通过π-π堆积与钙钛矿表面缺陷钝化，同时其两亲性结构降低ALD前驱体扩散势垒，促进SnOx致密生长；界面互锁效应抑制了热应力下的分层与离子迁移。

**性能/结果**：反式器件实现27.08%冠军效率（认证值），在85°C/85%RH湿热测试、-40°C至85°C热循环及最大功率点追踪下分别保持初始效率的95%、92%和90%超过1000小时，显著优于未修饰器件。

**机理/发现**：手性钙钛矿的强自旋-轨道耦合与手性诱导的自旋选择性（CISS）效应协同作用，实现了载流子自旋极化的高效注入与辐射复合，其g<sub>lum</sub>值由手性转移效率与钙钛矿晶格畸变程度共同决定。

**学术价值**：该工作首次将超分子限域概念引入钙钛矿电子传输层设计，为同时解决界面缺陷钝化与电荷传输有序化提供了普适性策略，并验证了其在大面积制备中的可行性。

**策略/方法**：引入共轭胺配体（如对苯二胺）在SnO₂表面构建一层“鲁棒-导电”分子中间层，通过配体两端胺基与SnO₂及钙钛矿的双向化学键合，同时实现界面缺陷钝化与能级对齐。

**机理/发现**：该配体层不仅通过Lewis酸碱作用有效钝化SnO₂表面氧空位及钙钛矿界面未配位Pb²⁺，还因其共轭结构促进载流子提取，并形成疏水屏障抑制离子迁移与水分侵蚀。

**性能/结果**：优化器件获得24.3%的认证效率（对照22.1%），且在85°C/85%相对湿度下运行1000小时后仍保持初始效率的92%，显著优于未处理器件（<60%）。

**学术价值**：提出了一种普适性界面分子工程策略，通过多功能配体设计同时解决界面电学与化学稳定性问题，为n-i-p结构迈向商业化提供了关键材料方案。

**学术价值**：首次从配体工程角度系统解耦表面钝化与载流子注入对称性的协同调控机制，为突破PeLED效率-亮度权衡瓶颈提供了普适性界面设计范式。

**性能/结果**：优化器件实现24.1%的功率转换效率（PCE），较未处理MXene/SAM器件（22.3%）提升8%，且未封装器件在85°C/85%相对湿度下1000小时后保持初始效率的90%。

**学术价值**：首次揭示退火MXene表面化学对SAM吸附构型及界面能级调控的微观机制，为倒置钙钛矿电池中HTL/钙钛矿界面设计提供可复用的化学修饰策略。
